**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 12.3 sits at the preferred position for NONCOMPETE — it expressly confirms nothing restricts Redwood from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, or operating in any field or territory, and records that we have made no non-compete commitment. This clause benefits us.

I checked for conflicting restrictions across the document: the only "competitor" reference (§ 24.2) binds Silverline's assignment rights, and § 13.4 is an ordinary acceptable-use limit on the Services, not a field-of-use restriction on our business. The § 2.2 "sole and exclusive provider" language and the § 12.4 post-term non-solicit are separate commercial terms handled under the EXCLUSIVITY and no-hire rules respectively, so they are not double-flagged here.
